reason: Confirmed in-scope claim c1: runtime probes (t9) show the kernel's output massively violates the contract tolerance abs(actual-exact) <= 1e-4 + 1e-6*abs(exact) for structured inputs at every legal N (64/128/256) — per-bin tone errors with err/tol up to ~1.13e6 and impulse-row violations of 122/252/508 components. This indicates a fundamental DFT correctness failure (bit-reversal/twiddle/reconstruction), corroborated by t15's extreme-input mix-case violations (max ratio ~2.4e8, no nonfinite outputs). The contract (problem.txt) explicitly requires the exact DFT formula for all N in {64,128,256} with the stated tolerance and 'no restriction on the input distribution or frequency content', so these inputs are squarely in the stated domain. c3 (input mutation/aliasing) is rebutted; c2 remains inconclusive but is immaterial since the same transform defect it probes is already decisively established by c1.
